settings.title: Booking pages
settings.introTitle: Let people book time with you
settings.introBody: Share a link and anyone (no account needed) can pick a free slot in your calendar. Bookings land in your calendar with a Zentico Meet link and both of you get an email.
settings.reconnectBody: Your booking pages can't reach your calendar anymore (the access key was removed or expired). Reconnect to take bookings again.
settings.keyNote: Zentico creates a dedicated access key on your account, limited to calendar and email, so the pages work while you're signed out. You may be asked to confirm with your account.
settings.handleHint: Only lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Your email isn't shown unless you choose to show it.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete "{title}"? Its link stops working. Existing bookings stay in your calendar.
settings.disableBody: Removes the access key: all your links stop taking bookings. Your pages are kept.
